Overview

Temuco is a city in AR with a population of 300,000. The gateway to Chile’s Lake District and Araucanía region, known for its Mapuche heritage and natural beauty. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
